running_thesis: Cboe (24 Nov): the Huang-driven rebound faded within a day. Nasdaq-100 closed 26214.17 (-1.99%), Nvidia down nearly 6% and about 37% below its October high, Anthropic 6.4% lower and below its IPO price. VIX 26.36, VXN 36.42, COR1M 24.62. The Digest read the vol spike as AI-specific rotation, not macro de-risking. 9 Dec hike priced (Polymarket 93.5%). Headlines (unverified): futures down over 2% on AI doubts and tariff reports. Core PCE and GDP due 14:30 CET today. Thursday is a holiday, Friday is a shortened session. Oil stale to 17 Nov.
open_questions: Do core PCE and GDP change the 9 Dec hike odds?
Does the AI unwind resume, or does Nvidia hold?
Does the tariff headline get confirmed?
Does Anthropic stay below its IPO price once weeklies list?
